themes_detail.label: Street noise spike
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints surged to 24 THIS WEEK, up 225% from a 7.4-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 8.08), signaling a sudden and acute quality-of-life disruption affecting residents across East New York/Cypress Hills.
evidence: 24 street/sidewalk noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 7.4-complaint weekly baseline (8-week average)
225% spike with z-score of 8.08, indicating statistically extreme deviation
Noise - Residential also among top 5 complaint categories overall (2,142 complaints over 90 days)
reporting_angles: What triggered the sudden noise surge this week? (construction, events, enforcement gaps)
Resident interviews on sleep disruption and quality of life; comparison to other high-noise NYC neighborhoods

themes_detail.label: Graffiti explosion
themes_detail.summary: Graffiti complaints skyrocketed to 33 LAST WEEK, up 595% from a 4.8-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.93), indicating either a coordinated tagging campaign or breakdown in rapid-response enforcement.
evidence: 33 graffiti complaints LAST WEEK vs. 4.8-complaint weekly baseline (8-week average)
595% spike with z-score of 5.93, among the highest statistical anomalies in dataset
Pattern suggests concentrated event rather than gradual deterioration
reporting_angles: Is this a coordinated tagging crew or gang activity? Interview NYPD, Parks Dept, community leaders
How fast does the city respond to graffiti removal in CD 305 vs. other districts?

themes_detail.label: Sidewalk and root infrastructure crisis
themes_detail.summary: Root/sewer/sidewalk condition complaints reached 10 THIS WEEK (up 186% from 3.5-complaint weekly average) and sidewalk condition complaints hit 18 LAST WEEK (up 177% from 6.5-complaint weekly average), combined with 10 missing street signs LAST WEEK (up 196%), suggesting accelerating street infrastructure decay.
evidence: Root/sewer/sidewalk complaints: 10 THIS WEEK vs. 3.5-complaint weekly average (z-score: 4.91)
Sidewalk condition complaints: 18 LAST WEEK vs. 6.5-complaint weekly average (z-score: 3.83)
Street sign missing complaints: 10 LAST WEEK vs. 3.4-complaint weekly average (z-score: 3.68)
Three overlapping infrastructure signals suggest systemic, multi-category degradation
reporting_angles: Walking tour of most-complained-about blocks; document tripping hazards and accessibility barriers
Interview DOT and Parks about maintenance backlogs and capital budget constraints in East New York

themes_detail.label: Illegal tree damage spike
themes_detail.summary: Illegal tree damage complaints reached 3 LAST WEEK, up 700% from a 0.4-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.42), suggesting either environmental crime or unregulated development activity impacting the district's canopy.
evidence: 3 illegal tree damage complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.4-complaint weekly baseline (z-score: 5.42)
700% spike from near-zero baseline, indicating emergence of new issue
May correlate with 521 DOB building permits filed in past 90 days (119 new buildings, 14 demolitions)
reporting_angles: Link illegal tree damage to active development projects (Constellation CB5, Baobab Village, Wharton Place rezoning)
Interview NYC Parks enforcement and developer compliance officers

themes_detail.label: Unleashed dog complaints surge
themes_detail.summary: Unleashed dog complaints reached 4 LAST WEEK, up 700% from a 0.5-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.95), suggesting either a new enforcement gap or emerging neighborhood safety concern.
evidence: 4 unleashed dog complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.5-complaint weekly baseline (z-score: 4.95)
700% spike from near-zero baseline, indicating sudden emergence
May relate to long-standing CB budget request for improved park/playground access and safety
reporting_angles: Interview residents on specific incidents and park locations; survey dog owners on enforcement awareness
Check NYPD Animal Care and Control response times and capacity in CD 305
